prompt: Who was previously appointed prime minister of the United Kingdom, becoming the first one to win a general election since Tony Blair in 2005?
answer: Keir Starmer. He became UK prime minister on 5 July 2024 and led Labour to victory in the 2024 general election—the first Labour general-election win since Tony Blair’s in 2005.
